decisions.reason: Substantial sunk investment in a multi-model sports flooring line and a public product page create escalation pressure to persist even if results are disappointing.
Similar to A, the committed resource investment and public presentation of a multi-model arena system make management reluctant to abandon it.
As a parallel multi-model mobile arena system with comparable investment and public commitment, escalation of commitment favors keeping it.
As the announced flagship close to the firm's style-led direction, its high visibility and central commitment make dropping highly unlikely.
Low investment, narrow niche, and peripheral fit to the firm's announced interior-style focus reduce escalation pressure, so disappointing results likely lead to dropping.
As a minor accessory with limited sunk costs and no central role in the style-led direction, it is easier to drop once results disappoint.
